qa_pairs.question: What should you always do when working on the electrical system for TCI and DME?
qa_pairs.answer: Always disconnect battery or interrupt power supply to ignition control unit and ignition coil when working on the electrical system (charging battery or welding, etc.) - dangerous primary and secondary voltage as well as danger of destroying the ignition system.

qa_pairs.question: What happens if you start the engine after removing the distributor cap or disconnecting wire on ignition coil term. 4?
qa_pairs.answer: Never start the engine after removal of distributor cap and/or disconnection of wire on ignition coil term. 4 - pull off plug on ignition control unit.

qa_pairs.question: When should you never disconnect the battery or leads on the alternator and starter?
qa_pairs.answer: Never disconnect the battery or leads on the alternator and starter while engine is running.

qa_pairs.question: What type of parts should be installed for TCI and DME systems?
qa_pairs.answer: Only install specified original BMW parts.

qa_pairs.question: Which ignition coil terminal should never have a shielded capacitor or test lamp connected?
qa_pairs.answer: Never connect a shielded capacitor or test lamp on term. 1 of the ignition coil.

qa_pairs.question: What is the restriction for connecting ignition coil term. 1 to ground or B+?
qa_pairs.answer: Never connect wire of ignition coil term. 1 on ground or B+. Consequently the ignition coil term. 1 wire must not be used to prevent engine starting when service installing a burglar alarm system.

qa_pairs.question: What should you do when checking compression for TCI or DME systems?
qa_pairs.answer: When checking the compression, pull off plug on control unit for TCI or master relay for fuel injection (relay no. 2) for DME.

qa_pairs.question: What is the minimum shielding requirement for the secondary side of the ignition system?
qa_pairs.answer: The secondary side (high voltage side) of the ignition system must be shielded with at least 4 k-ohms, whereby the original distributor rotor with 1 k-ohm shielded resistor must be installed.

qa_pairs.question: What distributor rotor resistance should not be used for radio shielding?
qa_pairs.answer: Do not use a 5 k-ohm distributor rotor for the shielding of radio and/or communication equipment.

qa_pairs.question: What ignition systems are covered by these working instructions?
qa_pairs.answer: These instructions are for working on Transistorized Coil-Type Ignition (TCI) and Digital Motor Electronics (DME).

qa_pairs.question: What are the potential dangers mentioned when working on the electrical system?
qa_pairs.answer: The dangers include dangerous primary and secondary voltage as well as danger of destroying the ignition system.

qa_pairs.question: What is the original distributor rotor shielded resistor value?
qa_pairs.answer: The original distributor rotor has a 1 k-ohm shielded resistor.
